# dns_naptr_record_set (Data Source)

Use this data source to get NAPTR records for a zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dns_naptr_record_set" "example" {
  zone = "example.com."
}

output "order" {
  value = data.dns_naptr_record_set.example.order
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Zone to look up.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name to look up. If not set, the zone is used.

### Read-Only

- `flags` (String) The NAPTR flags string.
- `id` (String) Always set to the zone.
- `order` (Number) The NAPTR order value.
- `preference` (Number) The NAPTR preference value.
- `regexp` (String) The NAPTR regular expression.
- `replacement` (String) The NAPTR replacement domain.
- `service` (String) The NAPTR service string.
- `ttl` (Number) The TTL of the record.
